subject: Conference follow-up: Inference & latency discussion
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@edgeai.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Conference follow-up: Inference & latency discussion

Hi Sara,

Great meeting you at the AI Edge Summit last week — really enjoyed your talk on on-device model orchestration. Thanks for taking a few minutes at the booth to chat about EdgeAI's low-latency inference goals.

Quick recap from our conversation:
- Use case: image classification for retail cameras with bursty traffic around store openings
- Current infra: mixed CPU/GPU edge fleet, models are quantized 4-bit and 8-bit
- SLO: aiming for 50-100ms tail latency on 99th pct for inference
- Primary priorities: latency first, cost second, then predictable SLAs (regional deployments)

Next steps I suggested: a 30-min discovery call to collect request patterns, model sizes, and a POC scope so we can produce a targeted throughput/latency estimate and a cost projection. Can you do one of these slots next week?
- Tue 2027-03-08 10:00-10:30 PT
- Wed 2027-03-09 09:00-09:30 PT
- Thu 2027-03-10 14:00-14:30 PT

If those don't work, tell me a few alternatives and I can coordinate. I can also loop in Rishi (our SE) for the call if you'd like deeper technical capacity during the discovery.

Attached is a one-pager on our Dedicated and Private deployment options — it outlines likely throughput and latency ranges for similar workloads.

Thanks again, and looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Sara Patel <sara@edgeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conference follow-up: Inference & latency discussion

Hi Marissa —

Great to meet you as well, thanks for the follow-up. We are definitely interested in exploring options — quick notes from my side:
- Models: majority are 4-bit quantized ResNet variants, peak QPS during openings ~400 requests/min per store, typical steady ~20-30/min
- Latency SLO: 100ms preferred, 50ms ideal for a subset of stores
- Budget: tight for this fiscal quarter, but execs are open to a POC if outcomes are compelling

I can do a call next week in the mornings (PST) — Tue or Thu should work.

Attaching our RFP for your review (EdgeAI-RFP.pdf). Can you share ballpark pricing ranges ahead of the call so we can set expectations with procurement?

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Head of ML Engineering
EdgeAI Inc
sara@edgeai.com

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — quick nudge on discovery call

Hi Sara,

Just wanted to follow up on my note and your RFP — checking whether Tue or Thu next week still look good for a 30-min discovery call. If priorities shifted or procurement needs more time, totally understand — a quick status update would help us align internally.

If it helps, we can start with a 20-min technical sync (Rishi + me) to scope a minimal POC that demonstrates the 50-100ms tail latency for a small subset of stores.

Appreciate any update when you have a moment.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Conference follow-up: Inference & latency discussion — quick check on timing/priorities

Hi Sara —

Rishi here (SE on Marissa's team) — looping in after Marissa's follow-up. Wanted to offer a quick option: we can produce a lightweight POC plan and a ballpark compute/price estimate based only on the items you shared in the RFP (no access required initially). If you’re still targeting a POC this quarter, we can prioritize and put together numbers within 5 business days.

If timing or priorities have changed, please let us know — we can also push this into a planning queue and check back next quarter.

If you're available, pick a 20-min slot here and I'll come prepared with an initial estimate: https://calendly.com/redwood-rishi/20min

Thanks and talk soon,
